title: Symbia Energy — point definition
description: A point DEFINITION (the model), not a reading. Deliberately close to Brick/Haystack so a real site tag export can be mapped in rather than a third convention being invented. The synthetic site in model/ validates against this, and so must any real export before it is accepted.

system.description: Top-level system. Determines which derive graphs consume it.

equip.description: Equipment class: utility, transformer, ups, busway, rack_pdu, chiller, cdu, crah, dry_cooler, weather, market

role.description: meter/sensor/status/signal are readable. setpoint/command are writable and MUST carry write_class.

unit.description: kW, kWh, degF, degC, gpm, pct, A, V, usd_per_mwh, gco2_per_kwh, or 'none' for status/bool.

max_age_s.description: A reading older than this is quality:stale. There is no default — every point must declare how long its value stays true. This is the single most important field in the model: without it a three-hour-old number renders as current, which is the same lie as a fabricated one.

rating.description: Design capacity in the point's unit. Required for anything compute.capacity consumes.

redundancy_group.description: Members of a group share a redundancy rule. Used by compute.capacity and by control preflight (no writes while a group is degraded).

fedBy.description: Upstream point ids. Topology for the one-line diagram AND for the energy-balance check: sum(fedBy children) should reconcile with this point.

balance_group.description: Points sharing a balance_group are checked against each other by the energy-balance graph. The parent declares balance_role:parent, branches declare balance_role:branch. This is the independent source of truth that catches drift, mis-mapping and double counting — the facility equivalent of a held-out partition.

write_class.description: read_only can never be written. advisory and gated require the control chain; gated additionally requires human approval at the uplift gate. Absent write_class on a setpoint/command is a model error, not a permissive default.

source.description: Field address the reading came from: mqtt topic, bacnet://, modbus://. Recorded on every reading so a number can be traced to a wire.
